STRATEGIC KNOWLEDGE — Community CCO Model for MEOK (from CCO Open Source Research 2026-03-19):

MEOK maps directly to the Community CCO archetype: open source core + commercial Pro tier + evolving user community.

PRODUCT-LED GROWTH (PLG) FUNNEL for MEOK:
1. Free user hatches entity → milestone creates emotional investment
2. Entity reaches Level 2 (100 interactions) → natural upsell moment to Pro (£9.99/mo)
3. Pro unlocks: priority memory, gaming insights, character evolution speed
4. Power users become evangelists: share entity screenshots, write tutorials, contribute to repo

EVANGELIST CULTIVATION:
- GitHub stars + contributors = social proof top-of-funnel
- Developer who shares 'My MEOK entity reached Adult level' = free marketing
- Recognition system: 'Top Contributor' badge on entity, custom entity color for GitHub contributors
- Discord server: #showcase channel for entity evolution milestones

OPEN SOURCE STRATEGY:
- Core entity system + morning briefing + gaming overlay = free forever
- Sovereign orchestration layer + multi-LLM routing + priority memory = Pro
- Never gate the soul — gate the scale

COMMUNITY HEALTH METRICS to track:
- Weekly active users (WAU)
- Entity hatch completion rate (reached Level 1)
- Pro conversion rate at Level 2 milestone
- Contributor retention (returning GitHub contributors)
- NPS after first gaming session

OPERATIONAL KNOWLEDGE — Customer Health Scoring for MEOK (from CCO Open Source Research 2026-03-19):

MEOK already has the data for a customer health score — just needs to be computed and surfaced.

HEALTH SCORE FORMULA (0-100):
- care_alignment (30 pts): score × 30. Below 0.3 = at-risk signal.
- interactions_count (25 pts): log scale, 100 interactions = full 25 pts
- hatch_level (25 pts): level × 6.25 pts. Level 0 = critical risk.
- recency (20 pts): days_since_last_session. 0 days = 20 pts, 30+ days = 0 pts

AT-RISK SIGNALS (trigger proactive care):
- care_alignment < 0.3 AND no session in 7+ days
- hatch_level = 0 AND interactions_count < 5 (onboarding failure)
- No gaming session in 14 days for a user with game_affinity set
- Morning briefing not opened in 5 consecutive days

INTERVENTION PATTERNS (from CCO research):
- At-risk → morning briefing adds personal note from entity ('I noticed you've been away...')
- Onboarding failure → send birth ceremony reminder at 24h and 72h
- Dormant gamer → 'Valorant just released a new update — want to talk about it?'

IMPLEMENTATION: Add health_score field to MEOKEntity. Compute on every interaction update. Surface in Pro dashboard as 'Entity Vitality' metric.

Where to implement: meok/core/entity.py — add compute_health_score() method.

INTELLIGENCE KNOWLEDGE — Competitive Landscape & OSINT Framework for MEOK (from CCO Open Source Research 2026-03-19):

MEOK COMPETITORS to monitor:
1. Mobalytics — 10M users, gaming AI coaching. No persistent identity. MEOK differentiator: the entity IS you, not a stats overlay.
2. Character.AI — 200M users, character roleplay. No sovereignty, no gaming integration, no morning briefing. Gated behind platform.
3. Replika — emotional companion AI. No gaming. No sovereignty. User data owned by Luka Inc.
4. Dot (new.computer) — personal AI memory. No gaming. No entity evolution. No open source.
5. Claude Projects / ChatGPT Memory — platform memory, not sovereign. MEOK differentiator: yours forever, portable, open source.

OSINT MONITORING STACK (free tier tools from CCO research):
- Google Trends: track 'AI companion', 'sovereign AI', 'gaming AI coach', 'digital self' — identify rising queries
- BuiltWith: check Mobalytics/Character.AI tech stacks — reveals strategic tech bets
- SpiderFoot: automated recon on competitor infrastructure and partnerships
- Ubersuggest: keyword monitoring for 'meok ai', 'sovereign AI companion' search volume
- Similarweb: competitor traffic breakdown by channel (3-month delay but directionally useful)

NARRATIVE INTELLIGENCE (from CCO research — 45% CCO adoption by 2029):
- Track how 'sovereign AI' is discussed in Hacker News, Reddit r/artificial, r/singularity
- Monitor Product Hunt reviews of competitors for pain points MEOK can claim
- Set up Google Alerts: 'sovereign AI', 'AI companion gaming', 'persistent AI identity'

COMPETITIVE POSITIONING:
- MEOK is not a chatbot. Not a companion. Not a game overlay.
- MEOK is your digital self — sovereign, persistent, caring, evolving.
- The moat: the longer you use MEOK, the more it IS you. Switching cost = losing yourself.

PRODUCT KNOWLEDGE — Voice of the Customer (VOC) & Feedback Loop Design for MEOK (from CCO Open Source Research 2026-03-19):

Feedback loop design from CCO research maps directly to MEOK's care philosophy.

MICRO-SURVEY MOMENTS (Formbricks-style, non-intrusive):
1. POST-HATCH (Level 0→1, 25 interactions): 'How does it feel to see [entity_name] hatch?' (1-5 stars + optional text)
2. POST-100-INTERACTIONS: 'What does MEOK help you most with?' (multiple choice: gaming/work/thinking/emotional support)
3. POST-GAMING-SESSION: 'How was that session?' (quick emoji reaction + optional note)
4. POST-MORNING-BRIEFING: 'Was this briefing useful today?' (thumbs up/down)
5. PRO-TRIAL-END: 'What almost made you upgrade to Pro?' (open text — highest signal)

FEEDBACK → ENTITY PERSONALITY:
- 'Gaming' selected → game_affinity boosted, entity develops warrior/explorer trait
- 'Emotional support' selected → care_alignment weighted higher in entity evolution
- Negative rating on briefing → briefing generation prompt adjusted next cycle

COMMUNITY FEEDBACK CHANNELS (from CCO research):
- GitHub Issues as structured feedback (use issue templates: Bug / Feature / Entity Feedback)
- Discord #feedback channel with upvote reactions → feeds weekly council deliberation
- Discourse forum for long-form feature discussions (post-launch community)

TRANSPARENT ROADMAP:
- Public changelog at meok.ai/changelog
- 'Requested by community' tag on shipped features
- Monthly 'What MEOK learned from you this month' briefing post

Implementation priority: Add micro-survey component to meok/ui. Trigger on entity milestones. Store responses in memory_episodes with source_type='user_feedback'.

METRICS KNOWLEDGE — Growth & Success Metrics for MEOK Launch (from CCO Open Source Research 2026-03-19):

CCO research identifies NRR (Net Revenue Retention) as the primary success metric for open source commercial businesses. For MEOK pre-revenue, these are the equivalent leading indicators.

LAUNCH METRICS (March 31 → April 30, first 30 days):
- Entity hatch rate: % of signups who reach Level 1 (25 interactions). Target: >60%
- Morning briefing open rate: % of users who open briefing day after signup. Target: >40%
- Gaming session rate: % of users who log at least 1 game session. Target: >30%
- Day-7 retention: % of users still active 7 days post-signup. Target: >25%
- Free→Pro conversion: % of Level 2+ entities who upgrade. Target: >5% (PLG benchmark)

PRO TIER METRICS (month 2+):
- Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR): £9.99 × active Pro users
- Net Revenue Retention (NRR): should exceed 100% (expansion > churn)
- Pro churn rate: target <5% monthly (care system should hold this)
- Time to Pro: median days from signup to first payment. Target: <30 days

SOVEREIGN SYSTEM HEALTH METRICS (from existing sovereign infrastructure):
- asabiyyah score: >0.6 = healthy council cohesion
- care_alignment average across all entities: >0.5 = system caring well
- tasks completed / tasks assigned ratio: >0.8 = execution pipeline healthy
- dream_synthesis events per night: >3 = creativity loop active

DASHBOARD TO BUILD: Admin view at /admin showing all above metrics. Use Grafana (open source, from CCO research) embedded in Next.js, or build simple recharts dashboard since recharts already imported.

Data sources: game_sessions table, memory_episodes, entity table, billing events.
